about: Voice-cursor calibration / feasibility spec (wiki/voice-cursor.md). ONE source of truth for the steps, the analysis settings and the per-person rules: the desktop test (extractor/voice_cursor_test.py), its scorer, and later the app's calibration all read this file. Everything is relative to the person: heights are anchored to their own low end, home note and high end, never to absolute notes.

analysis.smooth_note: pitch and formants are averaged over >= one vibrato cycle (vibrato is 5-7 Hz, so 143-200 ms) before any steadiness test

intro: Your comfortable pitch range: first two slow glides on an open “ah”, low to high,
then hold your lowest and your highest note you could hold for a while WITHOUT straining.
Comfortable, not extreme: this becomes the top and bottom of the screen.
Your “home note”: the note you hum most easily, without thinking. Hum it 3 times, about 2 s each.
It is the middle of your screen, and in daily use a 3 s home note re-centres your range.
Five heights, like a staircase: 1 = your comfortable low end, 3 = your home note,
5 = your comfortable high end, 2 and 4 halfway between. Each prompt shows a number: start
from silence and go straight to that height, no warm-up slide, and hold it about 1.5 s.
Hum or “ah”, whichever you like. No feedback on purpose: this measures whether you land on
Hold a vowel, mouth open, for about 2 s at the height shown: LOW = near your low end,
HOME = your home note, HIGH = near your high end. Keep the vowel clean and steady;
the height doesn't have to be exact.

steps.pos_note: pos is the place on the person's own low..home..high scale: 0 = low, 0.5 = home, 1 = high (piecewise, so an off-centre home note is fine)

rules.rows: floor(range_st / (rows_sd_factor * repeat_sd_st)), capped at max_rows: the number of pitch rows this person hits reliably; range_st = high anchor - low anchor
rules.columns: per pitch band: 'vowel' (3 columns: oo left, ah centre, ee right) if that band's leave-one-take-out vowel accuracy >= vowel_acc_min, else 'snap' (height picks a screen band, short hums step through the tappable elements in it)
rules.verdict: GO if rows >= min_rows and at least one band uses 'vowel'; SNAP-ONLY if rows >= min_rows but every band snaps; NO-GO if rows < min_rows
